entries.title: Reus

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Reus is a god-game/resource-management strategy game released first on Windows on May 16, 2013. Later releases followed on Linux, macOS, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One, while Steam keeps the Windows PC version available and bundles it with Reus 2. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it is the original release, has the clearest current storefront path, and avoids console capture limits.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release. The soundtrack edition is optional media and not needed for gameplay completeness.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or gameplay-complete edition split was found.

entries.title: Reus 2
entries.definitive_edition: Reus 2 Complete edition on Windows PC, pending future-DLC recheck

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Windows PC presentation with released DLC.

primary.version: Current Windows PC release with released biome DLC
primary.why: Reus 2 released first on Windows on May 28, 2024, with a Mac release following in 2025. There is currently a Complete edition bundle with the base game plus Ice Age, Everglades, and Grasslands, with a Jurassic DLC coming soon. Windows PC is the preferred archive route because it is the original and current lead platform, and because the released DLC is easiest to manage there.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release with the released biome DLC packs installed. Recheck the Jurassic DLC before a final archive run because it is still coming soon on Steam.

entries.remaster_caveats: Jurassic is currently coming soon on Steam, so the Complete edition covers released biome DLC but should be rechecked before calling the archive route final.
